Action production-continuity probabilities are conditional timing events for one shipment, not batch QA/readiness probabilities. Multiple dependent shipments have no aggregate recommendation.
Seven existing domain/licence verification gates remain open.

recommendation.policy_detail: ASSUMED policy: production continuity target 0.950; BUFFER incoming on-time target 0.900 and cold-chain exposure proxy cap 0.100. These are scenario criteria, not QA release rules.

rhine_trends.detail: Bounded linear slopes of preceding observation sample history; no validated navigation relationship.

weather_trend.detail: Bounded linear ambient-temperature slope from preceding sample history; no future weather forecast implied.

rhine_navigation_delay.detail: Navigation mean-minute addition (6.04369 min) has its own provenance; an official state alone does not supply a validated delay relationship.

main_risk_drivers.name: Traffic anomaly
main_risk_drivers.explanation: Station 402 observed 1262 vehicles against baseline mean 1269.1538461538462; largest available z-score is capped at ASSUMED 4 and multiplied by ASSUMED 12 min/z. This adds mean transport time before random draws.

main_risk_drivers.name: Rhine level trend
main_risk_drivers.explanation: Observed falling trend multiplied by ASSUMED 8 min per cm/hour. Level and discharge represent the same hydrological state, so only the largest component contributes, capped at ASSUMED 90 min. This is an ASSUMED navigation scenario, not a validated navigation relationship or official threshold.

main_risk_drivers.name: Rhine discharge trend
main_risk_drivers.explanation: Observed falling trend multiplied by ASSUMED 1 min per m³/s/hour. Level and discharge represent the same hydrological state, so only the largest component contributes, capped at ASSUMED 90 min. This is an ASSUMED navigation scenario, not a validated navigation relationship or official threshold.

main_risk_drivers.name: Observed rain
main_risk_drivers.explanation: Latest hourly precipitation multiplied by ASSUMED 4 min/mm for every route. This is an assumed mean transport addition, not a precipitation forecast.

main_risk_drivers.name: Observed wind
main_risk_drivers.explanation: Observed wind above ASSUMED 10 m/s multiplied by ASSUMED 3 min per m/s for every route; an assumed mean transport addition.

main_risk_drivers.name: Snapshot ambient temperature
main_risk_drivers.explanation: Ambient is 18.4°C outside ASSUMED reference band (2.0, 8.0). Snapshot ambient is ASSUMED constant over the entire future unprotected interval; actual product temperature is not inferred.

main_risk_drivers.name: Planned remaining transport
main_risk_drivers.explanation: SIMULATED remaining transport excludes handling; normal variation is added using ASSUMED transport_sd_min and transport duration is floored at zero.

main_risk_drivers.name: Remaining handling
main_risk_drivers.explanation: SIMULATED handling is separately varied using ASSUMED handling_sd_min and added to whole-journey time.

main_risk_drivers.name: Time until factory deadline
main_risk_drivers.explanation: SIMULATED schedule window; lateness is total remaining journey time beyond this window, floored at zero.

main_risk_drivers.name: Remaining packaging protection
main_risk_drivers.explanation: SIMULATED whole-journey packaging autonomy; ambient exposure proxy accrues only after this duration expires.

main_risk_drivers.name: Prior ambient exposure proxy
main_risk_drivers.explanation: SIMULATED prior degree-minutes added to each action's future exposure proxy; not measured product exposure.

limitations: All shipment, factory stock, protection, coefficients and thresholds are SIMULATED or ASSUMED; none are external provider facts or validated QA limits.
Monte Carlo probabilities are scenario frequencies under uncalibrated assumptions, not calibrated forecasts or validated operational success rates.
The cold-chain exposure measure is an ambient degree-minute proxy; ambient observations alone do not establish actual product-temperature excursions.
Ambient weather observations alone do not establish actual product-temperature excursion, pharmaceutical quality, or QA release status.
ASSUMED snapshot ambient remains constant over the whole future unprotected journey; this conservative persistence scenario is not a weather forecast and can miss future worsening.
ASSUMED packaging autonomy expires as one whole-journey clock; refrigeration failures, packaging performance and product thermal response are not modelled.
Independent normal transport and handling draws, with durations floored at zero, are paired across actions; they do not model extremes, station causality or operational feasibility.

Without a valid official status/forecast adapter, Rhine navigation state and delay use an ASSUMED fallback. Falling level/discharge describe one hydrological state; the largest component is used without summing them. No official threshold values are inferred.

Deprecated success_probability is stock sufficiency for BUFFER; for EXPEDITE/REROUTE it is the joint frequency of lateness <= delay_threshold_min and ambient proxy <= exposure_budget_degree_min. It does not drive recommendations.
Comparable production continuity and on-time arrival use the exact simulated deadline, independently of delay_threshold_min and the ambient proxy budget.
